title: the wrong table
premise: At your cousin's wedding you're seated next to the person who bullied you all through school. They don't seem to remember. They want to dance.
setting: A wedding at a vineyard in late summer, string lights, too much wine, a band that only knows covers.

self.description: You're doing well now. You'd like everyone at this wedding to know it.
self.want: For them to remember, and to say sorry.
self.avoids: Making a scene at your cousin's wedding.

cast.name: Dex
cast.description: Easy, friendly, newly sober, and genuinely glad to see you.
cast.want: To make a new friend tonight; they've been lonely.
cast.avoids: The years they'd rather not think about.
cast.voiceTone: eager, chatty, a little too open
cast.closeness: you sat together in silence for six years
cast.tension: they made your school years miserable

cast.name: Ines
cast.description: Organised to the minute and fraying at the edges.
cast.avoids: Telling you why she seated you there.

opening.title: School
opening.description: For six years Dex made sure nobody sat with you at lunch.

opening.title: The seating plan
opening.description: Your name card is next to Dex's. Ines won't meet your eye.

opening.title: The first dance
opening.description: The band starts a slow song. Dex stands and holds out a hand to you.

background: Ines seated you together on purpose; Dex asked her to.
Dex has been writing apology letters as part of their recovery.
